alt: 鄰里居民接力搬運沙包，一起築起防水圍堤保護社區菜園。
scene_prompt: 和衷共濟 means people unite in purpose and work together to overcome difficulty. In a modern neighborhood after heavy rain, residents of different ages form a coordinated line, passing sandbags hand to hand to build a low flood barrier around a community garden. Their gestures show mutual trust, shared effort, and cooperation; each person contributes, no one struggles alone. Water is shallow and safe, no damage or panic. Natural anatomy, hands visibly attached and passing each bag securely; sandbags supported by arms or set on ground, plausible low barrier and perspective. Original characters, child-friendly.
